title: Great app! Really enjoy using it! But few very basic features are still missing...
body:
I really enjoy using this app! Was waiting for a long time, till google released it for iOS.
But as for me, there are several very basic features that are still missing:
1. You can't send specific notifications... I mean you can create them for yourself, but not send them. Let say you are about to do party. You send your friend an event. You want to notify them 1 day before, so they would remember to prepare. Than notify once more several hours before the event, so they could remember doing something specific, and then 1 hour before, so they wouldn't be late. You can't set notifications for participants. You can actually set 3 different events, but you'll be considered a spammer, as 1 event for 1 party is more then enough.
2. You can't set push notifications on the phone, when using the web version. Lets say you create a new event for your for your whole family for today evening. You're doing it while you're working and using the PC (web version). And you want all of them to be notified by a push, but not an email... You can't. You can't even set a push notification for yourself. You'll need to create it at web, and then edit it on your phone... Too much work for such a simply task, don't you think? 
3. There is no "inbox" box or whatever you call it. So you can't see new invitations. It seems to be very native to see it in app in one place, so you could accept it from an app as you can do it from an email you get. But instead you need to go to the specific date, and there it is waiting for you :)
4. The app doesn't create an event in the native iOS calendar. Not that it must to have, but if you want all the apps, working with calendar to know of the upcoming event' you'll need to workaround with additional synchronizations... Waze for example uses the native iOS calendar to drive you to the event, so you'll need to sync the google calendar with the iOS calendar' (which you may be don't want do to for some reason)...
So considering the above, if your wife making an appointment for you to take the kid to a doctor, instead of her making most of the job setting all the notifications for me she wants and me just accepting it on an app... She'll do her job, then I'll accept it on a PC, while reading an email, and then, I'll find this on an app' and modify the notifications... And not to forget the synchronization, if you want waze to drive you there automatically.
Not too friendly as I see it.
But after all its a great app!
